title: Can AI Judge You? An Empirical Audit of Deployment Readiness in LLM-assisted Hiring Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.20140v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Delegating resume screening to large language models (LLMs) requires organizations to establish whether they can distinguish candidates by relevant qualifications while allowing only authorized users to change screening rules or approve exceptions. To this end, we develop a system architecture that separates candidate evidence, evaluation, permission controls, and assessment record, and empirically examine two complementary dimensions of its deployment readiness. First, we assess its operational readiness on four LLMs using a controlled experiment on 210 resumes across 14 job roles and six decision interfaces. Second, we assess its compliance readiness by testing how it handles unauthorized user requests and instructions embedded in resumes. translated_title: AI能评判你吗？对LLM辅助招聘系统部署就绪度的实证审计
translated_abstract: 将简历筛选工作委托给大语言模型（LLM）时，组织需要确认系统能否依据相关资质区分候选人，同时只允许被授权的用户修改筛选规则或批准例外。为此，我们开发了一种将候选人证据、评估、权限控制和评估记录相互分离的系统架构，并从两个互补的维度对其部署就绪度进行了实证检验。第一，我们通过一项涵盖210份简历、14个职位角色和6种决策界面的受控实验，评估了该系统在4个LLM上的运行就绪度。第二，我们通过测试系统如何应对未授权用户的请求以及嵌入在简历中的指令，评估了其合规就绪度。我们发现，运行性能取决于评估界面的选择：标量分数通常比简单的通过/不通过判断更能有效地区分资质变化，而比较类……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种将候选人证据、评估、权限控制与评估记录分离的LLM辅助简历筛选系统架构，并通过涵盖210份简历、14个职位和6种决策界面的受控实验，从运行就绪度与合规就绪度两个维度实证审计了其部署就绪度，发现标量分数比通过/不通过判断更能有效区分资质变化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-assisted resume screening architecture that separates candidate evidence, evaluation, permission controls, and assessment records, and empirically audits its deployment readiness across two dimensions—operational readiness (where scalar scores distinguish qualification changes better than pass/fail judgments) and compliance readiness (resistance to unauthorized requests and instructions embedded in resumes).
